title: nlist.walk

messages.description: sets the depth and goes to its start, a negative depth walks through all of them
info on 'goto' (1 if it found the index, 0 if not) and 'skip' messages
when walking on the given depth reaches the end

arguments.description: nested list name to bind to

methods.description: goes back to the start of the current depth
skips the current element, sending its indexes as 'skip' to the middle outlet

body: [nlist.walk] walks and browses through the elements of a nested list one at a time, at a given depth or through all depths in turn (unlike [nlist.iter] and [nlist.traverse]). It starts at depth 0.
